title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
lede: diagram-design is an agent skill that has Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents draw diagrams as a single self-contained HTML file with inline SVG, in one restrained editorial style.

points: The README lists 51 diagram types, from architecture and sequence diagrams to Sankey, Wardley maps and Gantt charts, each in light, dark and editorial variants.
The agent picks the type, states a plan and places elements on a 4px grid, with CI checks for overlaps and clipping.
It can pull a site's palette and fonts so later diagrams match a brand.
It redraws existing Mermaid, draw.io, Excalidraw and PlantUML files, and exports to SVG or PNG.
The README is candid on limits: output varies by model and run, and with no diffable source, Mermaid still suits docs that change every sprint.
